name: nagisa
description: Nagisa — a small Japanese island where people gather. Real-time multiplayer 3D web world.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nagisa/server && npm run test:world && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:app && npm run test:roam
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nagisa/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nagisa/server && npm run typecheck -w @nagisa/client
